topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: Virtually no investment will give you returns to match an 18% interest rate on your credit card.
question: Why does the source recommend paying off high-interest credit card debt before investing?
answer: Because the source says virtually no investment will match an 18% credit card interest rate. Paying off that debt can therefore be a better choice than investing while the balance remains unpaid.
